Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Touqeer for IM 6609
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error_dist('0331');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error_dist ('0501');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date < :eff_date and
 :term_date is not null
 then
 next_item;
 show_error_dist ('4503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id is null
 then
 begin
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(customer_id,7,4))),0)+1
 into :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 from customers
 where customer_type = :customer_type
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message('Error in generating new customer ID');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := substr(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,1,3)||
 '-'||:customer_type||
 lpad(:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id,4,'0');
 end if;
 :valid_customer.customer_id := :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id;
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 :VALID_CUSTOMER.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE := v_local_date;
 --:last_modified_date := sysdate;
 :valid_customer.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 message('Msg: Please note the new ID');
 pause;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_HYPHEN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_hyphen ( tmp_no in out VARCHAR2) is
 tmp_len number;
begin
 tmp_len := NVL(length(tmp_no), 0);
 if tmp_len not in (7,10,8,12)
 then
 show_error_dist('0323'); -- invalid length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if ltrim(tmp_no, '-0123456789') is not null
 then
 show_error_dist('0220'); -- invalid number
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if tmp_len = 7
 then
 tmp_no := substr(tmp_no,1,3) || '-' || substr(tmp_no,4,4);
 elsif tmp_len = 10
 then
 tmp_no := substr(tmp_no,1,3) || '-' || substr(tmp_no,4,3) ||
 '-' || substr(tmp_no,7,4);
 end if;
 exception
 when others
 then
 null;
end;
